notes: Adds a diagnostic line to each drive card showing what the USB-bridge SMART probe did (and whether the app is running as administrator), so when an NVMe-in-an-enclosure reads 'Can't read' it's clear exactly why — e.g. 'USB-bridge probe: asmedia=scsiNo realtek=OK' or 'NOT running as administrator'. The bridge SMART reading itself is the fixed 0.70.52 build. Note: reading SMART through a USB enclosure needs the app to be run as administrator.
